central_idea: Separate surfaces become one synchronized gesture

concepts.visible_event: Three overlapping surfaces fan outward and are joined by a moving optical sweep.
concepts.reason: One coordinated gesture makes independent layers legible.
concepts.risk: May resemble generic card animation without distinct motion.

concepts.visible_event: Three different letter scales resolve into a single baseline.
An illustrative cursor selects and aligns surfaces.
concepts.reason: Shows a cause for the alignment.
concepts.risk: No real product evidence; must stay fictional.

selection_reason: Shows both multi-layer choreography and a distinct optical pass before an elastic volume arrival.

beats.visible_event: Cards fan outward from a shared center as headline arrives on a curve.
A moving lens refracts the cards, then they leave in a staggered cascade.
A solid chrome surface arrives, compresses and settles under a new headline.
